title: The Slow Garden
author: Beatrix Iversen
blurb: Jonah Fairweather, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
